name: Notiqoo – Order Notification & Customer Chat for WooCommerce
author: Sarankumar

sections.description:
Notiqoo (formerly WC Messaging) is a powerful WooCommerce WhatsApp notification plugin that integrates directly with the official WhatsApp Business API. It delivers fast, automated WhatsApp Notifications for WooCommerce orders, including order confirmation, order updates, and customer alerts—ensuring reliable communication through the WhatsApp API.

“We’ve rebranded! WC Messaging is now Notiqoo — with the same features, same settings, and improved performance.”read more

New Update: Added support for blocked checkout and enhanced WooCommerce WhatsApp Integration for smoother message delivery and improved WhatsApp chat performance.

To use Notiqoo, you need a dedicated mobile number that is not connected to WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business on your device. This number will be used exclusively for the WhatsApp Cloud API, enabling reliable WhatsApp Order Notification, customer chat, and automated alerts. You will still receive calls and SMS on this number, but it cannot be used in the WhatsApp mobile app.

This is a requirement from Meta: a number can be used either for the WhatsApp API or the mobile app, not both. read more about WhatsApp Cloud API number requirements.

Notiqoo Pro : Takes communication to the next level with full two-way WhatsApp Chat, allowing customers to contact your business instantly for support, queries, or follow-ups. It also enables real-time WhatsApp Customer Chat, Click to Chat, WooCommerce WhatsApp Chat, and enhanced customer engagement—making Notiqoo one of the most reliable WhatsApp Message Plugins for WooCommerce.

Additionally, Notiqoo Pro supports simple abandonment cart recovery through targeted WhatsApp Notifications, helping store owners recover lost sales and improve conversions.

With powerful features like WhatsApp Business Messaging, WhatsApp Notification, WhatsApp Order Notification, WooCommerce WhatsApp Integration, WooCommerce WhatsApp Chat, and automated message flow, Notiqoo ensures a seamless communication experience for every WooCommerce store owner.

Powerful WhatsApp Notifications for WooCommerce

  1. Send automated WhatsApp Notification when a new WooCommerce order is placed, ensuring instant updates through the WhatsApp Business API.
  2. Send WhatsApp Notification for WooCommerce orders placed using the COD payment method.
  3. Send WhatsApp Notification for WooCommerce order status updates such as Processing, Completed, Failed, Refunded, and more.
  4. Send WhatsApp Notification for custom WooCommerce order status updates, fully compatible with your store’s workflow and WooCommerce WhatsApp Integration.
  5. Send WhatsApp Notification for abandonment cart recovery, helping store owners automatically reach customers who abandon their carts and boost conversions.

Notiqoo Pro| Documentation|Demo| Video Guides| Support

Notiqoo [free version]

  • Send WooCommerce order notifications: Automatically send WhatsApp Notifications for WooCommerce orders using the official WhatsApp Cloud API, ensuring fast and reliable order updates for customers.

  • Custom trigger buttons: Notiqoo provides custom trigger buttons on the WooCommerce order details page, allowing store admins to instantly send pre-defined WhatsApp Message Templates to customers with a single click—perfect for quick WooCommerce WhatsApp Communication.

  • Abandoned Cart Recovery: Enable automated WhatsApp Abandonment Cart Recovery messages to recover lost sales directly from the Notiqoo Chat Dashboard, helping you boost conversions and improve customer engagement.

Notiqoo Pro [premium version]

  • All features of the free version: The premium version includes everything from the Notiqoo Free plugin, offering complete WhatsApp WooCommerce Integration along with advanced communication tools.

  • Enable two-way messaging with customers: Notiqoo Pro allows full two-way WhatsApp Chat, enabling businesses to send and receive messages directly. Using the webhook system, admins can instantly receive customer messages sent through WhatsApp for real-time communication.

  • Compatibility with WooCommerce Booking plugins: Seamlessly integrates with popular WooCommerce booking extensions, offering powerful WooCommerce WhatsApp Integration for booking confirmations and notifications.

  • Quick Reply: Notiqoo Pro includes a quick reply feature that helps store admins respond to customer queries instantly, improving support efficiency through WhatsApp Customer Chat.

  • Mark as Read: Easily mark all messages as read, making message management smoother and ensuring an organized WhatsApp inbox.

  • Block users: Block unwanted users directly from their chat window. Once blocked, both the business and the customer are restricted from sending further WhatsApp messages to each other.

  • New Contact Addition from Chat Screen: Add new WhatsApp contacts directly from the chat panel and begin conversations without leaving the dashboard.

  • 24-Hour Messaging Window Timer: Automatically track the 24-hour WhatsApp messaging window to ensure compliance with WhatsApp Business API rules and timely message handling.

  • Quick Note Feature: Add and manage internal notes during customer conversations, helping store admins maintain context, remember details, and improve follow-up actions.

  • Message Templates: Use customizable WhatsApp Message Templates for fast, consistent, and professional replies—ideal for automated workflows and repeat communication.

  • Labels: Organize and categorize customer chats using labels. This helps filter conversations, segment customers, and streamline follow-ups inside your WhatsApp CRM system.

  • Dedicated Chat Menu: Access all chat-related features from a standalone chat menu, providing a cleaner interface and faster navigation for WhatsApp communications.

  • WhatsApp Interactive Flows: Manage multi-step customer journeys with interactive WhatsApp flows, guiding users through structured, step-by-step chat experiences.

  • Document Send/Receive: Send and receive documents directly through the Notiqoo Chat Dashboard, making WhatsApp communication more efficient for order confirmations, invoices, and support files.

  • Customized Widget: Access multiple chat widget styles that allow customers to start a WhatsApp conversation instantly from your website.

    1. Click to Chat: Generate a Click to Chat link that you can place anywhere—emails, blog posts, marketing pages—allowing customers to open a WhatsApp chat with your business instantly.

    2. WhatsApp QR Code: Provide customers with a scannable WhatsApp QR Code that opens your business chat instantly. Ideal for product pages, brochures, invoices, and offline marketing materials.

    3. WhatsApp Chat Icon: Enable a customizable WhatsApp Chat Icon on your website. Configure label text, default message, icon design, and position to encourage customer engagement.

    4. Shortcode: Use the shortcode [woom-chat-widget] to display the WhatsApp chat icon anywhere on your website for flexible placement.

10 Key Advantages of Notiqoo Pro

  1. Instant WooCommerce WhatsApp Notifications
    Send automatic WhatsApp Notifications for orders, updates, bookings, inquiries, and abandoned carts. Customers stay informed faster, boosting trust and engagement.
  2. Real-Time Two-Way WhatsApp Chat
    Communicate directly with customers using WhatsApp Chat. Send messages, receive replies instantly, and manage conversations from your WooCommerce dashboard.
  3. Built-In WhatsApp CRM Tools
    Organize chats with labels, quick notes, and quick replies. Mark messages as read to streamline communication. A lightweight WhatsApp CRM for WooCommerce.
  4. Abandoned Cart Recovery
    Recover lost sales with automated WhatsApp Notifications for abandoned carts. Timely reminders encourage customers to complete purchases.
  5. WhatsApp Notifications for Forms
    Get notifications for submissions from Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, WPForms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, and Fluent Forms. Automate WooCommerce WhatsApp messages for leads and inquiries.
  6. Multiple Customer Engagement Options
    Customers can start a chat via Click to Chat links, WhatsApp QR codes, chat icons, widgets, or shortcode. Makes contacting your store easy and instant.
  7. Interactive WhatsApp Flows
    Guide customers step-by-step with multi-screen WhatsApp Chat flows for support, bookings, forms, or data collection.
  8. Advanced Contact & Message Management
    Add contacts, block users, track the 24-hour messaging window, and send/receive documents—all from the Notiqoo dashboard.
  9. WooCommerce Booking Plugin Support
    Send automated WhatsApp confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups for bookings. Perfect for service-based businesses using WooCommerce Booking plugins.
  10. Faster Support & Higher Conversions
    Improve response time, provide real-time customer support, recover abandoned carts, and increase sales—all via WhatsApp Business.

Notiqoo Pro Add-on Plugins

Enhance the capabilities of Notiqoo Pro with two advanced add-ons designed to boost productivity and automate customer engagement through WooCommerce WhatsApp Notifications and WhatsApp Chat.

Teams for Notiqoo

Teams | Documentation | Demo | Video Guides |Support
Collaborate seamlessly with your team using a shared inbox, chat assignment, role-based access control, and a fully responsive web app optimized for desktop and mobile.
Empower your support team to work efficiently, stay organized, and deliver a consistent customer experience via WhatsApp Business.

Automator for Notiqoo

Automator | Documentation | Demo | Video Guides |Support
Streamline customer communication with WhatsApp automation. Automator for Notiqoo lets you send instant or scheduled WhatsApp Notifications based on WooCommerce order statuses and custom rules.
Set up intelligent workflows using rule-based triggers, and personalize every message with dynamic variables like customer name, order details, and more.
Reduce manual tasks, respond faster, and keep your customers informed automatically, enhancing your WooCommerce WhatsApp Integration.

sections.installation:
Upload the ‘Notiqoo’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Go to the plugin settings page and enter your WhatsApp Business API credentials.

Customize your message templates and order status settings according to your preferences.

Start sending automated order status updates to your customers on WhatsApp!
sections.faq:
Is it free plugin?

Yes, Notiqoo is a free plugin, but we also offer a premium version with advanced features of WhatsApp for WooCommerce. This article will explain how to send free WhatsApp notifications for WooCommerce orders.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest WooCommerce version?

Yes, this WooCommerce WhatsApp plugin works with the latest WooCommerce version and the latest updates of this WooCommerce WhatsApp API integration plugin support the WooCommerce blocked checkout feature.

Can this plugin be used to send a free WooCommerce order notification on WhatsApp?

yes! This WooCommerce WhatsApp plugin lets you send free WooCommerce order notifications on WhatsApp.

Is it possible to use my current WhatsApp number as my WhatsApp API number?

No, it’s not possible to use your existing WhatsApp number for the WhatsApp Business API. A phone number registered with the WhatsApp Business Cloud API can’t be used for the WhatsApp app. Once a number is registered with the WhatsApp Messenger or WhatsApp Business app, it can’t be registered elsewhere unless it’s deleted first.

Is it possible for an admin to receive notifications for all orders?

Yes, If you’re integrating WhatsApp for WooCommerce and the admin wants to receive notifications for all orders, they should navigate to WooCommerce settings, then go to Templates, and select the “Sent to Admin” checkbox option.

Where can I find the requested access token,WhatsApp business Id and WhatsApp phone id

In WhatsApp business cloud Api integration, To find the requested access token, WhatsApp Business ID, and WhatsApp phone ID, you need to set up Facebook WhatsApp configuration. Once everything is set up correctly, you can obtain the required data.

Does this plugin support international WhatsApp messages?

Yes, definitely! If you’re using the Notiqoo plugin for WhatsApp with WooCommerce, it supports all country codes and international messages.

What’s included in the free plan

The free plan of the Notiqoo plugin includes integration of WhatsApp Business API with WooCommerce. It allows send free WooCommerce WhatsApp order notifiction using template messages, sent directly to customers via WhatsApp.

How do I activate my pro plan

To activate your Notiqoo-WhatsApp integration for WooCommerce pro plan, simply follow these steps: Visit our documentation section or watch our video tutorial for easy guidance.

Is there a live demo for Notiqoo

Yes, we offer a live demo of the WooCommerce WhatsApp integration on our website.You can check it out there! of WooCommerce WhatsApp plugin demo.

Can we continuously chat using the Notiqoo plugin?

Yes, absolutely! You can continuously chat using this WooCommerce WhatsApp chat plugin. However, according to Facebook’s guidelines, customers need to start the conversations on Messenger. Admins can respond within 24 hours. After that, admins cannot start new chats but can send template messages when needed. If the customer starts another chat, admins can reply and continue the conversation.
